intro: What you are inside, and the agent that answers for him.

items.title: Into the Agent
items.summary: A descent through his work, drawn in code: thirteen chambers under one scroll, built with three.js and TypeScript, every chamber read from the same Markdown the written site and the agent use.
items.body: Nothing here is typed twice. The chambers are generated from the portfolio's content files, so a new project, paper or role appears here on the next build. It measures itself before the gate opens and picks the render setting that holds a steady frame on your machine; a machine that cannot hold one is sent to the written site.

items.title: Dumbledore
items.summary: The agent that answers questions about him on both sites: a Python LangGraph graph with measured retrieval, a reranker vote, a grounding check and a five-gate refusal pipeline, on a ₹0/month stack of free models.
items.body: Ask it about a project, a paper or a number and it reads the same content these chambers are built from, then a second model checks the answer against the passages it came from. It can take you to a page: say "open the LCSNet paper" and you are there.

items.title: Ask it anything about him.
items.summary: Where he has worked, what the knee X-ray pipeline does, which paper came first, what he would bring to your team. It answers from his record and says so when something is not in it.
